findings.issue: D3 says `git_io.rs` hash_object and the git paths are replaced by sc_agent_types::git. The WORKTREE read still hashes through a local `git hash-object` spawn and a local `git_command` helper. RBQA-F006 is only half closed. Not owning crates/sc-agent-types/** does not make the deliverable optional, and the sprint doc did not plan this exception.
findings.required_correction: Choose one route and record it in the plan. (a) Add a blob-hash helper to sc_agent_types::git and call it from git_io.rs, either in this sprint with owned_paths amended or in a sprint that owns git.rs. (b) Amend D3 and the RBQA-F006 closure through the planning process so the local spawn is a planned, owned exception. Do not leave the deliverable silently unmet.

findings.issue: The r-3c notes say the decision on the leftover `Command::new` is routed to r-3b. The r-3b doc adds the `Command::new` disallowed-methods entry 'once r-2 and r-3c have moved every git caller to sc_agent_types::git'. It names item-level expects only for git.rs, command.rs, extract/mod.rs and test helpers. It does not mention crates/sc-treesitter/src/git_io.rs (`git_command`). With the current tree, r-3b's workspace clippy would fail, or r-3b would have to edit a file it does not own. Nothing in r-3b carries the routing.
findings.required_correction: Update r-3b (its owned_paths and its expect list), or add the blob-hash helper in an owning sprint before r-3b, so exactly one sprint owns the git_io.rs spawn. Make r-3c's note point at that concrete item.
